gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Ethereal Starborn leaves big gaps between letters and drags a heavy band of lowercase through every line. Noto Sans Arabic handles the everyday reading, clear and tall with wide openings on small letters.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-batak: Dreamy Starborn floats, its letters set far apart. Shrink Starborn small and its wide gaps drift apart, whereas Noto Sans Batak keeps a towering x-height and an open e.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksu: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads sturdy and approachable, with open apertures. Paragraphs of text in it should move along easily, while Starborn, ethereal and widely spaced, keeps the heading dreamy.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Ethereal Starborn drifts, with huge gaps between its letters. It earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Brahmi adds a high mean line and open-ended curves.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: Dreamy Starborn leaves wide gaps between letters and presses a heavy lowercase band into every line. And Noto Sans Cherokee sits beneath it as a tall, approachable band, so the page feels light above and sturdy below.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Spacious and dreamy: Starborn floats its letters far apart, with a heavy lowercase band running through each line. Noto Sans Deseret holds up if enlarged, its open apertures and squat ascenders staying clear.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Huge stretches of blank space separate Starborn's letters, and a heavy lowercase band runs through every line it sets. Starborn sets the mood; Noto Sans Elbasan does the reading, large and open.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, its open apertures keeping each word easy to follow. And Starborn, ethereal and loosely spaced, hangs above it like mist over solid ground.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Wide blank space between letters makes Starborn drift, with a heavy lowercase band through every line. Noto Sans Ethiopic is the tall, sturdy one, built for steady reading.
